title: The meaning of holiness
english: “Be holy because I am holy” (Leviticus 19:2). In the scriptures the name of holy is applied not only to men but also to places and vessels. Learn the force of the name so that you may fulfill the work.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is exhorting his hearers to holiness, explaining that the word 'holy' in Scripture applies not only to people but also to places and vessels.

title: Hearing without doing is deaf
english: Keep my commandments and do them. Hearing without doing is deaf. The one who does the will remains.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is exhorting his hearers to obey the commandments, after explaining that holiness applies to persons, places, and vessels.

title: Sin punished by death: separation from God
english: Sins punished by death are separation from life with God. Death of the soul. Choose life. Amen.
translator_notes: True OET: no ANF; do not copy Barkley FOTC 83.
orientation: Origen is concluding his moral application of the Levitical precepts, warning that sin brings death understood as the soul's separation from God, and urging the hearer to choose life.
